defect: The rewritten SplitStringMapInternal returns false when a map key is empty ('Key can not be empty'), so casts like '{=1}' that the old FindKeyOrValueMap accepted now fail.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this new early return with an empty-key path, and the old code passed an empty key to HandleKey without error.

defect: CreateEntry passes the parameter 'name' (the dependency's own name) to SetFrom instead of the proxy's member name, and Scan still filters on 'prefix', which the new constructor no longer initializes, so it matches every entry.
reason: Both lines come from this change; the fix uses this->name/this->type/this->schema and filters Scan by FromMangledName, which needs the header to see the shadowing and the empty prefix.

defect: The fix stops ConvertStructToVariant from adding struct keys of NULL structs to the dictionary (and only adds a D_ASSERT in this file), so the dictionary no longer holds keys beyond the keys list.
reason: Struct keys were added to the dictionary regardless of NULL rows before this change too (old AddString loop); the repair is in struct_to_variant.hpp and this change only swapped the dictionary container.

defect: The regenerated deserializer uses TableFilterType::OPTIONAL, which does not exist (the enum value is OPTIONAL_FILTER), so the file does not compile.
reason: The fix reverts exactly this case label; the enum in table_filter.hpp at this commit only has OPTIONAL_FILTER.

defect: TempDirectorySetting::SetGlobal only re-derives the default max_temp_directory_size when the new temp directory is non-empty, so setting temp_directory to '' leaves a stale disk-space default instead of 0.
reason: The fix drops the new non-empty guard so SetDefaultMaxSwapSpace (which yields 0 for an empty directory, in config.cpp) always runs when the size was not set explicitly.

defect: Pin reloads an unloaded block only when is_pipe is true, although pipe buffers are allocated non-destroyable and only non-pipe buffers can be evicted, so evicted file buffers are pinned without reload.
reason: The inverted Pin condition (and is_pipe initialised from OnDiskFile) were written in this change; the fix flips the condition to !is_pipe.

defect: The new verification in FinalizeCheckpoint throws an InternalException when new segment starts do not chain from col_data.start, which the author found to be an incorrect invariant.
reason: The fix removes exactly the check added here as 'incorrect'; whether segment starts can legitimately differ needs the segment and row-group code.

defect: Node4::DeleteChild marks the freed node as LEAF_INLINED before Prefix::Concat; when prefix aliases node (no prefix above), Concat receives a leaf as parent and violates its D_ASSERT(!parent.IsAnyLeaf()).
reason: The SetMetadata line is new in this change and the fix removes it (FreeNode already clears the node); the aliasing and the assertion live in art.cpp and prefix.cpp.

defect: The new benchmark cache is keyed only by 'tpcds', so after the scale factor changes a cached database of another scale factor is loaded and benchmarked.
reason: The cache lines are introduced here and the fix adds the SF to the cache name; a reviewer can see the key ignores the SF macro defined at the top.

defect: After changing state from reference_wrapper to a raw pointer, operator= still asserts RefersToSameObject(state, other.state), which now compares the addresses of the two pointer members and fails for any two distinct iterators.
reason: The member type change is in this diff; the fix rewrites the assert to compare *state, and RefersToSameObject's generic overload is in helper.hpp.

defect: input_chunk and lambda_chunk are initialized once and reused across ExecuteExpression calls without reset, so vectors left referencing earlier slices/results corrupt later lambda evaluations.
reason: Moving the chunk initialization out of ExecuteExpression is this change; the fix ('bug caused by reusing chunks') creates fresh chunks per execution, which relies on ExpressionExecutor semantics.

defect: The new test uses a C99 array designator 'char str[] = { [41] = '\1' };', which is not valid C++ and fails to compile on MSVC and warnings-as-errors builds.
reason: The test file is new in this change and compiled into the unittest target; the fix ('Fix compilation') replaces the initializer with 'char str[41]'.

defect: In this file the fix only replaces the probe_count estimate for MaxThreads with the child's estimated cardinality; the correctness repair is in JoinHashTable::ProbeAndBuild.
reason: probe_count computed at source-state creation only affects parallelism (0 means sequential scheduling), and ProbeAndBuild in join_hashtable.cpp was not touched by this change.

defect: CreateStringUpdate updates min/max with an inner loop over all update strings (shadowing i), including NULL entries whose string data is invalid, for every non-null row.
reason: The nested loop was added in this change and the fix (#599) replaces it with a single update_min_max for the current string.

defect: MapExtractBind now uses child_types[1].second (the LIST of values) as value_type instead of its child type, so map_extract returns LIST(LIST(value)).
reason: The old code took child_types()[0].second of the value list; the fix wraps the new line with ListType::GetChildType.

defect: The rewritten CurrentTimeFun::RegisterFunction builds the ScalarFunction without the name 'get_current_time', so the function is registered with an empty name.
reason: The old AddFunction passed 'get_current_time'; the fix adds the name back to the constructor.

defect: The new WAL/database mismatch checks in ReplayVersion throw SerializationException, which WAL replay treats as a torn WAL and silently ignores, so a mismatched WAL is skipped instead of reported.
reason: The fix changes these new throws to IOException; the swallowing of SERIALIZATION errors is in the replay catch handlers outside the diff.

defect: The new STRUCT_EXTRACT type check rejects a child of type SQLNULL (as produced by macro binding with NULL), which struct_extract previously accepted.
reason: The check is added in this change and the fix exempts SQLNULL; that SQLNULL reaches this path needs the macro binder.

defect: ToString appends ' WITH ORDINALITY' after BaseToString has already added the alias (and originally had no return statement), producing unparsable 'f() AS t(a) WITH ORDINALITY'.
reason: The fix moves WITH ORDINALITY before the alias in exactly these new lines.

defect: CreateTable binds a BaseTableRef and discards the returned BoundTableRef, so the bind context used for generated-column expressions references a destroyed LogicalGet, causing a segfault.
reason: The fix ('fixed segfault in CreateTable') reverts to building a LogicalGet that lives for the whole binding; the lifetime issue needs Binder::Bind and bind_context.

defect: The new loop that finds the first valid child list uses j-- instead of j++, so it inspects only the first child and leaves offset stale when that child is NULL.
reason: The loop is new in this change and the fix changes j-- to j++.

defect: The ODBC test includes 'catch_stacktrace.hpp', which is not on its include path (the header is duckdb/common/catch_stacktrace.hpp), so the ODBC test fails to build.
reason: The include is added here and the fix corrects the path; the header's location is outside the diff.

defect: The new COLUMN_TYPES handling throws when a named column is missing from a file, which breaks union_by_name reads where a column exists only in some files.
reason: The throw is introduced by this change and the fix skips it for union_by_name; the multi-file union_by_name path is in read_csv.cpp.

defect: SetQuoted/SetEscaped are declared static inline in the header but defined only in base_scanner.cpp, so other translation units that use them from the template get undefined references (Windows build fails).
reason: Both the inline declaration and the out-of-line definition are from this change; the fix moves the bodies into the header.

defect: The new QueryRelation::Bind calls BindNode(SelectNode&) directly without SetRootStatement, skipping the CTE-map handling of BindNode(QueryNode&) and leaving the root statement unset.
reason: This override is new and the fix calls BindNode(*stmt.node) and sets the root statement; the difference between the overloads is in binder.cpp.

defect: UnzipCommand reads and writes a single BUFFER_SIZE block, so larger gzipped files are truncated or rejected by the bytes-vs-file-size checks.
reason: The command is new in this change and the fix replaces the single read with a read/write loop until EOF.

defect: The match_sel shortcut does match_sel.Initialize(state.keys_to_compare_sel), aliasing the probe state's buffer, so later probes overwrite the matches the scan structure still uses.
reason: The shortcut (with its own TODO doubting it) is added here and the fix ('bug fix because of selection') removes it; the buffer lifetimes are in the caller.

defect: Advance no longer re-pins when it crosses into the next var-size block, so DataPtr keeps using the previous block's dataptr/offsets during the merge comparison.
reason: This change removed Pin() from Advance and the fix restores pinning when block_idx advances.

defect: The new D_ASSERTs require names.size() == scan_types.size()-1, which fails whenever the index covers a subset of the table's columns (names holds all table columns).
reason: The fix relaxes these new asserts to <= and indexes names by column_ids; what names holds is decided outside this file.

defect: duckdb_table_description_error is re-declared taking duckdb_table_description * while the implementation takes duckdb_table_description by value, a conflicting extern C declaration and wrong public API.
reason: The declaration is added in this change and the fix corrects the parameter; the implementation signature is in table_description-c.cpp.

defect: JDBC startup uses DBInstanceCache::CreateInstance, which throws if the path is already cached, so a second connection to the same database file fails (#5371).
reason: The fix switches this new call to GetOrCreateInstance; CreateInstance's throw is in db_instance_cache.cpp.

defect: ODBC SetConnection uses DBInstanceCache::CreateInstance, which throws when an instance for the path is already cached, so reconnecting to the same file fails (#5371).
reason: The fix switches this new call to GetOrCreateInstance; CreateInstance's throw is in db_instance_cache.cpp.

defect: ArrowMetadataGetValue declares an unused local 'size', which breaks the warnings-as-errors build.
reason: The file is new in this change and the fix ('warnings turned errors') only removes that variable.

defect: ScanToDictionaryVector declares 'result_data' and never uses it, which breaks the warnings-as-errors build.
reason: The function is new in this change and the fix ('warnings-as-errors') removes that unused variable.

defect: The Windows GetWorkingDirectory calls SetCurrentDirectory(count, buffer) instead of GetCurrentDirectory and compares the length off by one, so it does not compile on Windows.
reason: The function is new in this change and the fix calls GetCurrentDirectory with the correct length handling.

defect: AddValue's escape removal calls escape_positions.front() right after popping the last element, which is undefined behaviour on an empty queue, and leftover positions leak into later values.
reason: The escape-removal loop is new in this change and the fix guards front() with an empty check and clears the queue.

defect: duckdb_create_value uses DUCKDB_TYPE_INT64, DUCKDB_TYPE_INT32 and Value::INT32, none of which exist, so the file does not compile.
reason: The function is new in this change and the fix renames them to DUCKDB_TYPE_BIGINT/INTEGER and Value(int32_t); the enum and Value API are in other headers.

defect: RemoveInequalityCandidate copies comparison types into the parent DelimJoin conditions by position without checking that the condition counts and columns match, and the planner updater still treats those joins as equality joins.
reason: The inequality path is new in this WIP change and the fix adds the count and column checks and skips such DelimJoins in VisitOperator.

defect: PushdownUnnest assumes each filter has at most one binding and dereferences bindings.begin() unconditionally, so filters referencing several tables (assert) or none (empty-set dereference) are mishandled.
reason: The file is new in this change and the fix checks every binding against the unnest index.

defect: OuterJoinMarker::Scan indexes found_match with gstate.scan_position, which is set to 0 and never advanced, so every scanned chunk is checked against the first chunk's match flags.
reason: The file is new in this change and the fix indexes by lstate.local_scan.current_row_index.
